what: The closed ProductManifest vocabulary that groups registered AnalyticalClauses into an audience-agnostic product by a computed selection scope, and the correction blast-closure that recomputes which products a lineage operation touches. Every object->clause->manifest->artifact edge is recomputed from a validated compilation and never trusted from a caller.
source_object_types_note: Closed and deny-by-default. entity/universe_release/exposure_edge/event/evidence_item/canonical_release are present in the synthetic clause bundle today; claim/episode are Codex-named valid types absent from this fixture; claim_proposition is reserved additive and unused until the Event Ledger delta ships it. A ref whose object_type is outside this set refuses manifest_source_object_type_unregistered.

scope:objects_touching_entity.what: Selects every clause whose proof_binding.source_object_refs include an entity ref equal to the bound entity_id.

scope:objects_touching_event.what: Selects every clause whose proof_binding.source_object_refs include an event ref equal to the bound event_id. Enables event-scoped products whose correction blast-closure is exercised directly when a lineage split/merge/supersede names that event.

scope_predicates_note: Closed and deny-by-default. selection_scope names a predicate_id from this registry and supplies bindings drawn from the named closed domain. A selection_scope carrying filter text, a field list, a lambda or a wildcard refuses manifest_scope_predicate_unregistered. The kernel computes the selected clause set; the caller never lists members.

correction_closure.reverse_dependency: every manifest with a clause_manifest edge from a clause whose object_clause edge referenced any predecessor object key
correction_closure.forward_scope_match: every manifest whose selection_scope predicate, recomputed against the post-operation release, selects any clause referencing any object key in the union of predecessors and successors
correction_closure.monotonicity: the affected manifest set is monotone non-decreasing in the union of predecessor and successor keys; a recomputation that drops a previously-affected manifest without a scope, clause or release change refuses correction_closure_shrank_without_cause
correction_closure.authority: every edge is read from a freshly validated and recomputed ProductCompilation; a caller-supplied object_clause, clause_manifest or manifest_artifact edge refuses manifest_caller_dependency_graph_supplied
correction_closure.lineage_input: the correction engine consumes predecessor and successor object keys only from a lineage operation already validated by the Event Ledger semantic-lineage extension; it never re-derives lineage semantics and refuses correction_lineage_operation_unvalidated on an unvalidated operation

protected_from_role_projection: A ProductManifest adds no renderer and no prose path. Every output_artifact_ref must be a rendering produced by the registered analytical-clause role projector; a manifest artifact that is not a registered role projection refuses manifest_artifact_not_registered_role_projection, and the cross-role protected-field invariant is inherited per artifact, not re-proved here.
claim_boundary: The compilation establishes that a product's clause set is the deterministic image of a registered scope predicate over a signed release, that every object->clause->manifest->artifact edge was recomputed and not supplied, and that a correction's blast radius is the monotone union of reverse dependencies and forward scope matches over predecessors and successors. It does not establish that the product is worth compiling, that the scope predicate is the right question, that any underlying number is true, or that the artifact is publishable. It makes a caller-authored dependency graph impossible to pass off as computed, not the product correct.
